summary: In-trade order-flow autopsy: winners vs losers once IN the position, with adversarial verify

result.summary: FLOW family screened on 713 trades (alive-at-h only: 520/442/315 at 3/5/10m), 2025-quantile thresholds, both-years evidence rules. Losers share a clear in-flight signature that winners almost never show, readable at 3 minutes: net delta signed AGAINST the position. fw_3<0 alone passes both criteria both years (wr 22-23% vs 47-51%), and the tail fw_3<=-23 (2025 q33) drops winners to 17% both years. The single strongest rule is the combination r_h<0 AND fw_h<0 (underwater with flow against): at h=5 it isolates a 15-16% win-rate, -0.62/-0.68 mR cell vs 48-56%/+0.44/+0.95 for everything else, passing at all three horizons and in both books and in B/B2 patterns; at h=3 it is already fully qualified (18%/11% vs 43%/50%), making 3 min the earliest reliable horizon. Supporting confirmations: fa_frac (majority-adverse minutes) and adv_press<0 (initiation against while underwater) both pass at h3 and h5; low relvol (dead tape after fill) passes at h5. All of these hold in Jul-Sep 2025, the worst regime in the sample (e.g. fw_5<0: 12% vs 45%; r<0&fw<0 at h5: 8% vs 38%), and the fw_5<0 monthly gap is positive 12 of 13 months. Honest nulls: eff_* carries no signal (even reversed in 2025); absorption (absorb==1) does NOT reliably predict recovery of underwater trades — the edge is flagging the underwater+flow-against cell, not trusting the absorbed cell; flow-sign information decays by 10 min. Recommended screen for the loss-cut rule family: at fill+3m, if trade is underwater and cumulative signed delta is against the position, exit; re-check at 5m with the same test plus relvol<=1.76 as a secondary confirm.
nulls: eff_* (path efficiency): NULL at every horizon. 2025 direction even reverses at h3 and h10 (low-eff trades win MORE: h10 <=q25 wr 51% vs 38%). The h5 PASS-R at q33/q50 is boundary (0.25-0.27R) with zero 2025 WR gap — not credible. Inefficient tape does NOT mark losers.

absorb_h==1 does NOT predict recovery. Among underwater trades, absorbed (absorb==1) vs not: h3 2025 wr 18% vs 18% (no gap); h5 2025 29% vs 15% and h10 2026 40% vs 10% show direction but fail n>=20-per-cell-per-year and are not consistent across years/horizons. Absorption is a weak, unconfirmable rescue signal — underwater is bad regardless of who is on the bid.
Overall absorb_h==0 split: null/reversed — absorb==1 trades LOSE more than absorb==0 (h3 2025: 18% vs 37%) because the flag requires adverse price; it is selection, not defence.

Underwater-only fw split (r_h<0 AND fw<0 vs r_h<0 AND fw>=0): NULL by rules at all horizons — 2025 h3 shows literally no gap (18% vs 18%); 2026 direction exists (11% vs 24% at h3) but cells <20 in 2026. Once underwater at h, flow-with does not reliably save the trade; the tradable edge is the r<0&fw<0 cell vs EVERYTHING else, not vs the absorbed-underwater cell.
fw_10 sign: null (2025 wr 38% vs 43%, gap 5pp). Flow sign information decays by 10 min among survivors; only the median split fw_10<=q50(+42) passes.
adv_press_h <= 2025-q50 (=0, i.e. any nonpositive): null at h3/h5 — the threshold must be strictly negative to carry signal.
adv_press tail among underwater-only (2025-UW q25/q33): inconsistent across years (2025 strong, 2026 flips at h3) — not usable.
fa_frac_10 >= q67 and adv_press_10 < 0: fail 2025 WR criterion at h=10 (gaps 5pp and 2pp).
relvol_3 <= q25/q33: fail (2026 WR gaps 4-7pp); relvol needs 5 minutes to become reliable.
Pattern A slices: all cells n<20 per year — untestable; combo effect is confirmed only in B and B2.
